digest.component_or_area: structured-output baseline eval harness in CI
propositions: Harness must capture raw LLM replies for each (provider, model) cell across current and sentinel directive variants, scoring deterministically on parse success and layout-class rates without exposing credentials to shared hosts.
Missing API key credentials are recorded as 'unmeasured' cells and skipped without failing the job; call budget cap is enforced before any network calls and unit-tested.
Workflow dispatch job scopes provider secrets per matrix arm; unit tests validate scorer golden counts on committed E2 fixture replies with exact counts pinned.
Workflow artifact bundle (raw replies + before/after score table) is uploaded and linked for operator attestation; live run evidence drives measurement decisions, not CI gating.
